summary: There is no universal c>0 such that N3(1/128), s3(A)>=1, E2(D)>1/48, E3(D)<2^-18 and E5(D)<1/1024 force sigma1(D)sigma2(D)>=c for a selected physical cross block D. A Sylvester-Hadamard spike/dust target family has sigma1(D)sigma2(D)=1/(4sqrt(2)M)->0 while satisfying every displayed condition. This refutes only the proof implication, not QFORM.
